description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class named LogFragment that encapsulates a log display component (LogView) within a ScrollView. It manages the creation of its view hierarchy, sets visual styles and padding, and updates scroll position when log text changes. The class provides access to the LogView instance for external use.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that displays log messages in a scrollable view, managing view creation, styling, and auto-scrolling on log updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll to the bottom when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance used within the fragment.
